name: Defibrillator
primary:
"Clear!" An electric jolt from your palm restarts an ally's heart: the ally you aim at within 24 blocks, otherwise the nearest one within 8, otherwise yourself. The target:
• Heals 3 ❤, twice as much below 30% health
• Loses poison and wither
• Charge 10
self_description: The jolt goes into your own chest: heal 3 ❤ (twice below 30% health), poison and wither removed.
